rationale: P0, P1, and overall coverage are all 100%. The 3 pgTAP files (supabase/tests/database/) were executed against a real local Postgres via `supabase start && supabase test db`, closing the 5 remaining acceptance criteria. Executing them required fixing a test-fixture bug (profiles rows already auto-created by the 0008 trigger) and a schema-wide missing-GRANT defect (migration 0015_grant_missing_table_privileges.sql) unrelated to Epic 21's own logic but blocking any live-DB execution.
